selected_pair_addendum.interpretation: In this single-scene live-feedback pair, A completed and B slid/rotated then lost the cup and timed out. B entered the pouring instruction; B never received liquid, and later pouring completion scores stayed far below the threshold. This is not merely an early-stop/terminal-label error. Prefix intervention supports a grasp/trajectory mechanism worth replication, but bitwise initial differences, scene specificity and divergent later live NN feedback preclude a single-cause or population-SR claim.
